legalGate.blockedTitle: Tailmance is not available for this legal context yet
legalGate.ageAssurance: This legal country requires an age-assurance step that Tailmance cannot yet verify with approved production evidence. Social access remains blocked until that requirement is available and verified.
legalGate.subnational: Tailmance still needs an approved state, province, territory, region, or other local-jurisdiction review for this legal context. Access remains blocked rather than guessing the applicable rules.
legalGate.subnationalLanguage: The required legal-language documents for this local jurisdiction have not yet completed external-counsel and professional-localization review. Tailmance will not substitute a different legal language.
legalGate.subnationalCountryMismatch: The stored local-jurisdiction code does not belong to the verified legal country. Tailmance blocks access instead of combining different countries’ legal contexts.
legalGate.applicabilityUnresolved: Tailmance has not yet completed the separate review of other laws that may apply because of residence, service relationship, current presence, storefront, or feature-specific facts. Your app language does not decide this review.
legalGate.applicabilityReview: The additional-jurisdiction review for this account is missing, stale, or not fully evidenced. Tailmance keeps the primary legal country separate and blocks access until every applicable overlay is reviewed.
legalGate.applicabilityDocuments: An additional applicable jurisdiction requires legal documents that are missing, stale, or not approved for this exact legal/document-language context. Tailmance will not replace them with another country or language.
legalGate.jurisdiction: This legal country has not yet completed Tailmance’s production legal review. Social access remains blocked until the required country review and evidence are approved.
legalGate.countryUnresolved: Your legal country could not be established from verified account evidence. Device language, travel location, and app-store country are not used as substitutes.
legalGate.countryExpired: The evidence used for your legal-country context is no longer current. Tailmance requires a fresh verified legal-country context before enabling social access.
legalGate.countryProvenance: Your legal country was based on a signal that is not sufficient on its own. App language, identity-document country, current travel location, and storefront country cannot silently determine legal jurisdiction. A verified residence/service-contract basis or legal review is required.
legalGate.jurisdictionExpired: The legal review for this jurisdiction is no longer within its approved review window. Access remains blocked until the country and each required legal control are revalidated.
legalGate.controlReviewIncomplete: At least one required legal-control review for this jurisdiction is missing, stale, or not attributable. Tailmance blocks access instead of relying on a partial country approval.
legalGate.documentManifest: The exact legal-document set for this country, local jurisdiction, app language, and document language is incomplete or no longer current. Tailmance will not substitute global or another-language documents.
legalGate.bundleMissing: There is no current approved legal-document bundle for this exact country and app-language context. Tailmance does not fall back to another country or legal language.
legalGate.localeUnsupported: This app language does not yet have an approved legal-document bundle for your legal country. Change only to a release-ready language with an approved bundle; Tailmance will not silently substitute another language.
legalGate.verificationFailed: Tailmance could not securely verify the current legal context. Access remains blocked until verification succeeds.
legalConsent.contextUnavailableTitle: Legal context could not be verified
legalConsent.contextUnavailableBody: Tailmance cannot enable social features until your legal country and the exact country/language legal documents are verified. A device language, travel location, or storefront guess is not used as a substitute.
legalConsent.title: Review the current community terms
legalConsent.body: Before you use Tailmance social and user-generated content features, review the current Terms of Use and Community Guidelines. The Privacy Policy / privacy notice is presented separately for information and is not treated as consent.
legalConsent.confirm: I confirm that I am at least 18 years old and accept the current Terms of Use and Community Guidelines.
legalConsent.confirmWithOverlays: I confirm that I am at least 18 years old, accept the current Terms of Use and Community Guidelines, and perform the acknowledgement or affirmative-acceptance actions clearly identified for the additional applicable-jurisdiction documents shown above. Informational notices and marketing consent remain separate.
legalConsent.note: Your legal evidence is bound to the current jurisdiction matrix, immutable bundle, document language, version and content hash. Informational notices are not recorded as consent. If the applicable context or a required document changes, Tailmance requires a fresh review.
legalConsent.failedBody: The current terms could not be confirmed securely. Check your connection and try again.
legalConsent.linkMissingBody: This legal link is not configured in this build.
legalConsent.linkFailedBody: The legal page could not be opened. Try again.
legalConsent.contextLoading: Verifying your legal country and document bundle…
legalConsent.contextUnavailable: Tailmance cannot record a binding acceptance until your legal country and the exact approved document bundle are verified. Language, storefront, or travel location alone cannot be used as a substitute.
legalConsent.contextLine: Legal country: {country} · App language: {uiLocale} · Document language: {documentLocale}
legalConsent.additionalDocumentsBody: Your verified circumstances may make additional jurisdiction-specific documents relevant. Review every document below. Tailmance records an action only where the current reviewed legal route explicitly requires acknowledgement or affirmative acceptance.
legalConsent.overlayAction.none: Information only · no consent or acceptance is recorded
legalConsent.overlayAction.acknowledgeme: Acknowledgement required · presentation and acknowledgement are recorded
legalConsent.overlayAction.affirmative_a: Affirmative acceptance required · your explicit acceptance is recorded
auth.ageLegal: I confirm that I am at least 18 years old. The legal links below are provided for review; binding Terms and Community Guidelines acceptance happens only after email verification.
auth.countrySignalHelp: This declaration is used only to select the correct pre-registration legal information. It does not set your final legal jurisdiction, and your app language does not determine your country.
auth.subnationalSignalHelp: This local-area declaration is requested only when the approved registration notice differs by state, province, region, emirate, or similar subdivision. It is not your final legal-jurisdiction decision.
auth.subnationalRequired: Select the applicable state, province, region, emirate, or other listed subdivision to load the correct registration legal information.
auth.legalLoading: Checking the current registration legal information…
auth.legalReady: Registration legal information is ready for review.
auth.legalUnavailable: Account creation is unavailable for this country and app-language context until the required legal information is approved and current.
auth.preRegistrationLegalHelp: The Privacy Notice applies to registration-time data processing. Terms and Community Guidelines are available for review here; binding acceptance is requested only after email verification and verified legal-jurisdiction resolution.
auth.privacyNote: The owner account is not displayed on the social profile. Identity, safety, and payment functions remain in the account layer.
premium.planDisclosure: Monthly auto-renewing subscription. Premium is optional; Standard remains available without a subscription. Cancel anytime from your store account.

premium.paymentNote: Payments on iPhone are processed by the App Store and payments on Android by Google Play. Tailmance does not see or store your card details. Price and applicable taxes are shown according to your store and region.

safety.title: Safety Center
safety.subtitle: You stay in control, your pet holds the identity
safety.heroTitle: Trust is never left to a single badge.
safety.heroBody: Tailmance combines verification, privacy, content moderation, and meetup feedback.
safety.item.verificationBody: Pet profile, owner identity, and veterinarian verification are separate signals. Badges increase trust but are not a safety guarantee.
safety.item.locationBody: Exact coordinates are never shown to other users. Discovery uses only approximate distance and the city/district/neighborhood information you choose.
safety.item.reportBody: Every pet profile and piece of content can be reported. Blocking cuts off discovery, social feed access, and messaging at the server layer.
safety.item.chatBody: There are no cold DMs. Messaging opens only after an active mutual match. Risky contact or payment details trigger a warning before sending.
safety.item.meetupBody: For first meetups, choose public, well-lit, pet-friendly places. You can share a meetup plan with someone you trust using your device share sheet.
safety.item.healthBody: Vaccination and health documents can be uploaded by the pet owner, but verified status is granted only through the trusted moderation/veterinary process.
safety.linkMissingBody: This destination is not configured in this build.
safety.linkFailedBody: This page cannot be opened right now. Try again.

reports.subtitle: Status of the safety reports you submitted

reports.refreshFailed: Report history could not be refreshed

settings.locationHelp: Location is rounded to about 100 meters on the device; other users see approximate distance, not coordinates.
settings.locationUpdatedBody: Approximate location is used privately for distance calculation only; other pet owners cannot see your coordinates.
settings.notifyMarketingHelp: Product announcements and campaign communications. Disabled by default.
settings.supportHelp: Official support for safety or account issues.
settings.manageStoreSubscription: Manage App Store / Google Play subscription
settings.manageStoreSubscriptionHelp: Payment method and cancellation are managed in your store account.
settings.exportDataHelp: Share the data package associated with your account.
settings.deletePermanentBody: Pet profiles, social content, health records, and private account data will be deleted. Manage any active store subscription separately in the App Store or Google Play.
suspended.title: This account is restricted
suspended.body: Social and discovery access is unavailable for this account. This restriction cannot be removed from the app. Contact support if you believe it needs review.
suspended.note: You can still export or permanently delete your account data and manage an active store subscription while access is restricted.
verification.title: Verification Center
verification.subtitle: Pet, owner, and health verification are independent
verification.providerMissing: The production identity-verification provider is not configured yet.
verification.petReceivedBody: The verification photo taken with the camera is not shown on the social profile. The review result is reflected in the badge status.
verification.heroTitle: Trust is more than one badge.
verification.petApproved: The pet verification review was approved. If profile identity details or photos change, the badge requires review again.
verification.petPending: Your private camera photo is being reviewed; this photo is not shown on the social profile.
verification.petUnknown: Pet verification status could not be verified from the server right now.
verification.petStartBody: Take a new verification photo with the camera, separate from profile photos.
verification.ownerApproved: Owner identity was verified by the external verification provider.
verification.ownerUnknown: Owner verification status could not be verified from the server right now.
verification.ownerStartBody: Identity documents are not uploaded to Tailmance servers; the verification provider returns only the result.
verification.healthBody: Health documents are kept in a private area and reviewed separately from the pet verification photo.
verification.note: Verification badges help reduce fake-profile risk; they do not guarantee another user’s behavior or the accuracy of all claims.
auth.serviceAgeRequired: You must confirm that you are at least 18 years old to create a Tailmance account.
contentSafety.contactOrPayment: For your safety, consider avoiding personal contact or payment details early in a conversation.
permissions.camera.title: Allow camera access?
permissions.camera.body: Tailmance uses the camera only when you choose to take a pet photo or verification photo. It does not request microphone access. If you continue, the system permission prompt will open.
permissions.location.title: Allow approximate location?
permissions.location.body: Tailmance uses location to calculate approximate distance for discovery. Coordinates are rounded to three decimal places before upload and are not shown to other users. If you continue, the system permission prompt will open.
permissions.notifications.title: Allow notifications?
permissions.notifications.body: Tailmance uses push notifications for account, match, message, health, and other enabled categories. Marketing product updates stay off unless you separately give versioned marketing-push consent. If you continue, the system permission prompt will open.
settings.marketingConsentBody: Marketing product updates are optional and use push notifications only. This does not authorize email, SMS, or phone marketing. You can withdraw at any time without losing Standard access.
settings.marketingDocumentsBody: Review the exact current base consent text and any additional applicable-jurisdiction marketing notices before granting optional push consent. A changed document set requires a fresh review.
settings.marketingConsentGranted: Versioned consent for marketing product-update push notifications was recorded.
settings.marketingConsentWithdrawn: Marketing push consent was withdrawn and the withdrawal was recorded.
settings.legalPrivacyCenterHelp: Terms, privacy notices, consent text, subscription information, moderation appeals, export, and deletion.
premium.reviewBody: Review the current subscription terms and consumer information for this legal context before opening the store purchase sheet.
premium.reviewCheckbox: I reviewed the current subscription and consumer information. This acknowledgement is not marketing consent, privacy consent, or a waiver of statutory rights.
premium.reviewRequiredBody: Review the current subscription and consumer information and confirm the review before continuing to the store.
premium.additionalConsumerDocuments: Additional consumer documents for this legal context
premium.additionalConsumerDocumentsBody: These documents are tied to the current applicable-jurisdiction matrix and document language. If the set changes before purchase, Tailmance stops the purchase flow and requires review again.
legalCenter.additionalApplicableDocument: These documents supplement the primary legal country because another reviewed jurisdiction or local rule may also apply. App language alone never creates this overlay.
legalCenter.title: Legal & Privacy
legalCenter.subtitle: Policies, choices, rights, and records
legalCenter.notice: Privacy notices explain processing; they are not a substitute for consent. Optional marketing-push consent is separate from Terms acceptance and can be withdrawn independently.
legalCenter.kvkkHelp: Information notice for Türkiye; it is not presented as “I consent.”
legalCenter.moderationInAppHelp: See user-visible reasons, appeal windows, and appeal outcomes.
legalCenter.accountDeletionHelp: Open the web deletion-request route without reinstalling the app.
legalCenter.contextBound: Uses your verified legal country and exact document-language bundle; no generic cross-country fallback.
legalCenter.contextUnavailableBody: This binding legal document cannot be opened until your legal country and exact document bundle are verified.
legalCenter.intellectualPropertyHelp: Rights-holder notice route; US §512 safe-harbor status is not assumed without real evidence.
legalCenter.accessibilityHelp: Accessibility support and country-specific legal-scope notice.
legalCenter.supportHelp: Open the support/contact route bound to this exact legal country and document language.
moderationAppeals.title: Moderation decisions & appeals
moderationAppeals.subtitle: Reasons, review, and outcomes
moderationAppeals.info: Eligible moderation decisions can be appealed within six months. Accepted appeals do not automatically mark a decision reversed until the underlying account/content state has actually been restored.

moderationAppeals.empty: No moderation decisions are currently associated with this account.
